subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: A cyclic sixth-power inequality under a fixed sum
units.statement: For a,b,c>0 with a+b+c=3, Cauchy gives Σ_cyclic a^6/(c²+2b³)≥(a³+b³+c³)²/(a²+b²+c²+2(a³+b³+c³)). Writing S2=Σa² and S3=Σa³, power means give S2≥3 and S3≥S2≥3. Hence S3²≥3S3≥S2+2S3, proving the lower bound 1. Equality holds only at a=b=c=1. Scaling a+b+c=3t and replacing 2b³ by (2/t)b³ gives lower bound t⁴ at a=b=c=t.
steps: Apply Cauchy to the three cyclic fractions
Compare the sums of squares and cubes by power means
Rescale variables and identify the equality case
